goal: A landing-strand stop event survives every archive sweep unresolved until git-truth or an operator clears it: the sweep never stamps a resolution on an unlanded strand, and a probe-confirmed landing appends a probe-attributed resolution marker and archives the otherwise-landed phase in that same sweep.

references: .flywheel/specs/00077-FEATURE-phase-archival-integrity.md -- criteria 3, 4; decision D-2; the shared-invariants paragraph of the Decomposition Hint
constraints: The resolution-marker attribution vocabulary is the shared invariant downstream tasks consume: a resolution marker carries a machine-readable attribution with the stable tokens "probe" and "operator" (queryable from the stop-event record, never parsed out of free-text detail prose); archival is never an attributor; export the constants from flywheel_orchestrator._claims so the sweep, the status surface, and the CLI verb share one definition

Scope: the spec-named landing-strand park kinds (divergent-base, uncommitted-work, standing-verify, protected-paths) stop being resolvable by the act of archiving; non-landing stop kinds keep the existing archival supersession marker so the two pinned stamping tests stay green unmodified
Criterion 3: repeated sweeps over a phase blocked by an unlanded strand append no resolution marker to that strand's stop events

Criterion 4 / D-2: when the sweep's ancestry probe confirms a stranded task's work is reachable from the landing base, it appends one probe-attributed resolution for that strand and archives the otherwise-landed phase in the same sweep, not the next one
Update every STOP_RESOLVED reader in this same change (_workflow.py ~499 stamping guard and ~1428 status clearing) so probe- and operator-attributed markers both clear a subject
Sqlite and postgres claim stores change together; if a schema column is added, update the postgres mirror DDL alongside
Commit the change (Conventional Commits) before reporting done
non_goals: Do not add the operator CLI verb -- that is resolve-strand-verb's slice
Do not change how status renders strands for absent task files -- that is stranded-surface-store-backed's slice
Do not recover or land stranded branches (spec 00076)
Do not modify or weaken assertions in the pinned test files
Do not read or write under .flywheel/verification/
edge_cases: A probe that always answers landed must fail: the non-ancestor strand from the criterion-1 harness must remain unresolved after repeated sweeps (the spec pairs criteria 3 and 4 deliberately)
A stop appended AFTER a resolution marker is a fresh recurrence and must surface again (existing append-only ledger convention)
A machine resolution masquerading as an operator decision must be distinguishable in the audit trail -- the attribution tokens are the discriminator the graders assert on
